faq.a: Yes. Infinite Cars is free to play in your browser, with no account, no download and no payment.

faq.q: Does Infinite Cars work on a phone?
faq.a: Yes. It runs in a phone browser, and the on-screen pad and swipe controls send the same keys as a keyboard.
